method: Visible browser controls and accessibility tree through CUA; separate CPU geometry/kinematics checks.

checks.observation: Both dashboards identify F22A6, 1993 EX sedan and 5MT; market remains unresolved.
Timing, transmission, intake, exhaust, top and underside captured. Comparison uses OEM plates and limited common-appearance photo; six stamp-verified photos are unavailable.
Fixed valve operation and segmented inlet shafts visible; exact cam contact-track geometry remains illustrative.
Keyboard 6 opens eight-port body view; I changes four secondary butterflies while paused. Uncontrolled primary ports stay open.
CPU checks verify separate rear input pulley, reversing gear pair and opposite rear shaft rotation. Geometry and tooth counts remain illustrative.
Keyboard 2, 3, 4 and 7 show valvetrain, internal drive, cylinder cutaway and separated assemblies.
Searching flywheel finds the manual system. Selection opens its purpose, connections and crank-speed motion.
Arrow orbit, plus zoom, period stepping and view shortcuts respond. Crank step advanced 132 to 162 degrees.
Air/fuel and oil controls toggle checked states in the schematic-flow panel. All remain marked schematic.
IAB search returns nine related entries; body and actuator selection show correct names and quantities.
Piston and IAB body/actuator visually reviewed; source mesh/material equality checked for all extracted entries.
Actuator scrubber accepts 50%; orbit and zoom controls respond; independent operation explained.
Piston playback advances scrubber, pause stops it, keyboard orbit changes view readout.
Removed synchronization-pin URL displays Spanish absence explanation; valid component chosen as fallback.
Actuator reference resolves to active KA intake diagram and PN17129-PT2-000; all catalogue numbers separately checked against saved OEM rows.
Atlas large-text and light/dark modes visually reviewed; complete-engine user settings restored to 140% text, 80% labels, dark theme and view labels.
Spanish Listen switches to Stop reading and back. Voice availability/pronunciation is browser/system dependent; no auditory quality assessment claimed.
No errors/warnings returned for the reviewed complete-engine and atlas tabs.

102 MP4s fully decoded and probed; 102 posters decoded; 102 WebVTT files exactly match the Spanish catalogue. All five poster sheets visually reviewed. Actual IAB video played in the atlas from the versioned f22a6 URL, duration12s, readyState4. Two timing-cover posters use a clearer frame from their matching clip.

notes: Exhaust shield intersections corrected after visual review.
Top/underside camera distance increased to retain intake duct in frame.
Camera-direction selector resets to a command prompt after use, preventing a stale direction label.
One render tab stalled at item57. Completed media were preserved; resumed from the verified manifest.
